source: https://jev-use-cases.com — the independent Jev builder directory, 532 ideas. These are the top 18 by X impressions, captured 2026-09-23. Impressions are the directory's own figures, not mine.

items.title: Instant tool-call compaction
items.author: @tamarajtran
items.summary: Score every tool call and drop what is irrelevant, instead of a summarization prompt.

items.title: Flight search
items.author: @gregpr07
items.summary: Jev wired to Browser Use, small LLM only for typing. Flights found in 7 seconds for $0.0039. Open-sourced.

items.title: Harness with Jev
items.author: @sydneyrunkle
items.summary: Agent harness where the LLM decides, the tool executes, the model evaluates, loop until done — Jev for the fast judgment steps.

items.title: Defense game (Flappy guardrail)
items.author: @rchan0687587257
items.summary: Reversed Flappy Bird: move the guardrail to protect the city from missiles controlled by Jev.

items.title: Live trading
items.author: @jarrodwatts
items.summary: Jev reads a price feed, chooses buy or sell, places real on-chain orders every 300 ms block. Open-sourced.

items.title: Real-time feed quality filter
items.author: @RBilgil
items.summary: Classify, filter or navigate a live feed from DOM signals in real time.

items.title: PR newsjacking
items.author: @elvissun
items.summary: Jev read 384 morning headlines and told 15 brands which stories to hop on — 24.9 seconds for $0.19, versus Claude Opus getting through 4 of 384 for $0.77.

items.title: Real-time game level generation
items.author: @HugoDuprez
items.summary: Generating game levels in real time off the back of faster, cheaper structured output.

items.title: Jev-as-a-Judge evals
items.author: @LangChain
items.summary: Benchmarked Jev against LLM judges on accuracy, repeatability, latency and cost for agent evaluation.

items.title: Postgres natural-language filter
items.author: @iam_zachi
items.summary: A PostgreSQL extension that filters rows in natural language with no index and no embeddings. 129 rows in ~1 second for $0.0009; 6 ms from cache.

items.title: Command safety review
items.author: @rauchg
items.summary: Jev as the shell-command reviewer in Vercel's fx — up to 18x faster at p95 and more accurate than the incumbent.

items.title: Keystroke file launcher
items.author: @dabit3
items.summary: Predictive launcher: typing "the pdf I just downloaded" already ranks the newest PDF, with a confidence on every keystroke, in ~100 ms.

items.title: Desktop computer use
items.author: @trycua
items.summary: Turns what the driver sees into bounded action IDs and lets Jev pick one. 44.9 seconds and ~$0.001 on one run.

items.title: Voice browser control
items.author: @moritzkremb
items.summary: Voice transcript to Jev, probabilities back in ~300 ms, the browser clicks. $0.0002 per decision.

items.title: SEO and GEO audits
items.author: @irabukht
items.summary: Cut the price of audit-and-fix agents ~90% via 30x faster reads of Search Console, citation scans and gap analysis.

items.title: GrokBot decision routing
items.author: @0xCodila
items.summary: prompt → bot → Jev decision → bot execution. A cheap, fast agent routing loop.

items.title: Resume-job relevance scoring
items.author: @h_nilforoshan
items.summary: Scoring resume against job description on a 2.5M MAU app. Human-labelled Spearman 0.79 at $0.02, versus 0.72 at $0.29 for a flash-tier LLM.

items.title: Bulk email classifier
items.author: @rileybrown
items.summary: 500 emails classified in seconds for 3.5 cents.
